rationale: Review started 2026-11-25T01:20:29Z and ended 2026-11-25T01:25:02Z. All cited held texts were re-hashed (every source_fingerprints file and every evidence record's text_path matched its pinned sha256) and every record's text equals its file slice at char_start:char_end. Read the held original (41 FR 47213) in full: Executive Order 11943 of October 25, 1976, Amendment of Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay and Allowances; the OCR text shows "The White House, October 25, 1976" but no legible signature name, so the signatory is attributed by date only; number, date, citation and subject match. The only operative sentence corrects a typographical error in Schedule 3 of EO 11941 ("2,611*" to "52,611*"), a self-executing amendment spent on issue; the basis OWN_TEXT:EO:11943#628 re-derives it (amends_parent EO 11941, effective 1976-10-25) and nothing else in the order carries a continuing command. The producer correctly treats EO 12010 Sec. 4 ("Executive Order No. 11941 of October 1, 1976, is superseded.", signed 1977-09-28, read in the held FR text and in PARENT_END:EO:11943>EO:11941>EO:12010) as ending the parent and thus the surviving corrected figure, not as this order's own end, consistent with the strike-and-insert and pothier rulings. The OFR "Superseded by: EO 12010" note and the 1989 entry are editorial leads explained by that parent supersession. The 5 U.S.C. 5332 note the producer quotes is held (theophilus-sources/usc-t5-s5332.txt) and reads as quoted; it is corroboration, not basis. Cruden found only the order's own FR text; no later revival. No history flags. Status no is supported.
